desc: 以暖金缎面与细金线图鉴串起的身体乳详情套组，从肌理痛点到收口共十一镜
name: 鎏金缎面丝滑身体乳款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢下点击，用暖象牙细金框把泵瓶与外盒干净地立起来。
主图一秒法则：用倾倒的鎏金缎带与空心环辉把首要利益一次讲完。
shots.textZone: upper right 45% carries one headline line plus one slim sub-line

shots.intent: 把干、糙、暗、松四种身体皮肤状态排成一行圆窗，让买家自我对号。
shots.textZone: one short label plate centred beneath each of the four circular windows

shots.intent: 用三行空心说明位承接机制解释，把可替换的事实留给后续填写。
shots.textZone: three stacked rows on the right, each pairing one capsule slot with one short line

shots.intent: 左右同机位同裁切的两块表面状态对照，让差异自己说话而不宣称结果。
shots.textZone: one short label plate at the foot of each panel

shots.intent: 把产品放进沐浴后的真实梳妆时刻，让买家代入而不是听宣称。
围绕泵瓶排六枚空心圆环徽标位，把四项可替换卖点挂进结构里。
shots.textZone: six ring slots arranged three left and three right, four of them carrying short labels

shots.intent: 用极低角度微距把泵头结构与膏体质地当成质量证据。
细金线方框里的六格多角度图鉴，一次性交代正背与开盖状态。
用五条空白参数行与一枚空心印章框承载真实凭证，杜绝编造资质。
shots.textZone: left column of five ruled rows plus one blank seal frame at the foot of the block

shots.intent: 以深棕缎带横幅与一枚空按钮位收口，把行动号召留给可替换文案。
shots.textZone: one headline line above the product and one empty pill-shaped action plate below it

style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm ivory field #FAF3E6 with one thin rose-gold #C99277 keyline frame, alternating with apricot satin drape #F1E2CB and honey board #E8D8BE, closing on a single deep cocoa band #4A3220; one poured amber-gold #B8813B ribbon sweep and one open ring halo recur as the connective motif
style.direction: warm prestige body-care commerce with gilded satin-ribbon styling and hairline keyline framing
style.iconSystem: hollow single-weight ring outlines and hairline rounded capsule slots in rose-gold #C99277, no filled pictograms, no medals, no check shields, no certification artwork
style.lightingSystem: bright warm high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with a fill card, one skimming accent reserved for texture and metal, soft contact shadows only, never harsh hotspots and never a cool cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm prestige body-care commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm ivory field #FAF3E6, apricot satin drape #F1E2CB, honey surface board #E8D8BE, amber-gold ribbon and hairlines #B8813B, rose-gold ring outlines #C99277 and deep cocoa type #4A3220; warm temperature throughout, never a cool grey or blue cast; bright warm high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and fill card, one skimming accent reserved for texture and metal, soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with one humanist Chinese sans, single family only; hollow thin-line ring badges and hairline rounded capsule slots as the only graphic components; product always upright at one stable scale with the carton kept to one side and never overlapped by props; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no photographic room clutter, no filled pictograms or certification artwork.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hue beyond the amber-gold and rose-gold pair
no mixed fonts, no serif, no script and no handwritten lettering
no cool grey or blue cast on any field, tabletop or highlight
no photographic room clutter, no real signage and no scenery outside the four stated fields
no filled pictogram icons, awards, seals or certification artwork
no change in bottle scale, upright stance or carton placement between shots
style.presentationRules: the bottle is always upright at one stable scale with its carton kept to one side or left out entirely, never overlapped by props, never resized between shots; the ring halo and ribbon sweep always sit behind the product
style.surfaceSystem: honey-toned matte surface board #E8D8BE and ivory lacquer tabletop #FAF3E6, both with a fine even grain and a soft contact shadow where the product rests
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for Latin paired with one humanist Chinese sans, single family only; headline weight in deep cocoa #4A3220, hairline rules and small caps in amber-gold #B8813B, all in-image wording supplied through placeholders rather than copied text
